src/core/memory/schema.ts: validates memory key, category and SHA-256 formats at the persistence/tool boundary
src/app/voice.ts: validates base64 audio format at the sidecar command boundary
src/config/schema.ts: validates the provider id format in the config schema
src/core/loop/context.ts: sanitizes tool call ids to the provider-accepted charset
src/core/attachment-reference.ts: validates the SHA-256 artifact filename format at the durable media boundary
src/core/subagents/definitions.ts: validates definition file names and splits the front matter block
src/mcp/tools.ts: sanitizes MCP tool names to the provider-accepted charset
src/providers/transport.ts: reads the URL scheme of a proxy address
src/providers/local-discovery.ts: checks that a header value is a decimal number
src/skills/schema.ts: validates skill names and front matter formats
src/store/checkpoints/store.ts: validates checkpoint hash and id file names
src/store/checkpoints/types.ts: validates the sha256 format in the checkpoint schema
src/store/events/index.ts: validates the session id format of an events file
src/tools/repair/schema.ts: repairs malformed argument formats from the model (markdown links, URL schemes)
src/util/redact.ts: detects secret formats (AWS, GitHub, JWT, PEM) before logs and UI
src/util/model-name.ts: display formatting of a model id, no behavior depends on it
ui/src/lib/model-name.ts: display formatting of a model id, no behavior depends on it
ui/src/components/DiffFile.svelte: builds a DOM id from a file path
ui/src/components/ProviderConnection.sve: validates the environment variable name format
ui/src/lib/markdown/render.ts: escapes HTML and validates the code fence language token
ui/src/lib/markdown/sanitize.ts: validates URL schemes and attribute formats for HTML sanitizing
ui/src/lib/platform.ts: reads the platform from the user agent string
src/config/schema-sections.ts: validates exact permission request SHA-256 format at the configuration boundary
